title: わたしのいちねんかん (Watashi no Ichinenkan)
description: A full year in first grade, told chapter by chapter through the seasons. Haru starts school nervous and alone, makes a best friend named Kota, learns to swim, performs in the culture festival, sees the first snow, and says goodbye to the school year under the same cherry blossoms where it all began. A rich, emotionally complete story of growing up.
author: オリジナル
